title: 565. Next Greater Element II

examples.explanation: The first 1 sees 2; 2 sees nothing larger in the circle; the last 1 wraps to 2.
Each element except the maximum 4 finds a larger successor, with the final 3 wrapping to 4.

hints: Scan twice around the array while keeping a decreasing stack of indices awaiting their greater element.
Only push indices during the first lap; the second lap only resolves pending entries.
Unresolved indices at the end keep -1.
